papers.title: Ifebemtinib plus garsorasib in previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer with KRASG12C mutation: a multicentre, randomised, phase 1b/2 trial
papers.authors: Song Z, Zhu L, Liu Y, Lin R, Li X, Luo Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Ifebemtinib is a potent oral focal adhesion kinase inhibitor. Preclinical evidence supports combining ifebemtinib with the KRASG12C inhibitor garsorasib. This study aimed to evaluate this combination in KRASG12C-mutated solid tumours.
METHODS: This multicentre, phase 1b/2 study had a phase 1b component to establish the recommended phase 2 dose and a phase 2 multitumour expansion component. In phase 1b, the safety and tolerability of ifebemtinib combined with garsorasib was assessed using a 3 + 3 design in KRASG12C-mutated solid tumours. No dose-limiting toxic effects were observed, and the recommended phase 2 dose was established as ifebemtinib 100 mg orally once daily plus garsorasib 600 mg orally twice daily. Here, we report the results of the cohort of previously treated KRASG12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer from phase 2 expansion. Eligible patients (aged ≥18 years) who had histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer harbouring the KRASG12C mutation, an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance-status score of 0 or 1, and had disease progression after previous irinotecan-based or oxaliplatin-based combination therapy, were recruited from seven of nine participating tertiary hospitals in China. On the basis of the recommended phase 2 dose, phase 2 comprised a single-arm study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of ifebemtinib combined with garsorasib and an open-label, randomised study in which patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive ifebemtinib plus garsorasib or garsorasib alone, by use of centralised computer-generated block randomisation with no stratification. Investigators were masked to the block size. The primary efficacy endpoint of phase 2 was investigator-assessed objective response rate (Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours, version 1.1), assessed in the safety analysis set in the single-arm study and in all randomly assigned patients (intention-to-treat population) in the randomised study. At least six objective responses (safety analysis set) were required in the single-arm study to proceed to the randomised study. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06166836 and NCT05379946, and is active but not recruiting.
FINDINGS: Between April 7, 2023 and Dec 13, 2024, 51 patients were enrolled in phase 2 (15 in the single-arm study and 36 in the randomised study). In the single-arm study, the median age was 53 years (IQR 39 to 63), nine (60%) patients were female, six (40%) were male, and all were Asian. In the randomised study, the median age was 51 years (IQR 42 to 59) in the combination group and 63 years (IQR 54 to 66) in the monotherapy group, 24 (67%) were female, 12 (33%) were male, and all patients were Asian. In the single-arm part, the confirmed objective response rate was 46·7% (95% CI 21·3 to 73·4). Seven patients had partial responses, triggering progression to the randomised study. In the randomised study, the confirmed objective response rate was 38·9% (95% CI 17·3 to 64·3) with the combination therapy versus 16·7% (95% CI 3·6 to 41·4) with garsorasib alone (between-group difference 22·2%, 95% CI -7·7 to 49·1; one-sided p=0·068). In the single-arm study, grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurred in four (27%) of 15 patients, and in the randomised study, grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurred in six (33%) of 18 patients in the combination group and five (28%) of 18 in the garsorasib group. Grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurring in at least two patients were diarrhoea (six [18%]), proteinuria (two [6%]), and intestinal obstruction (two [6%]) in patients treated with combination therapy (combined), and increased alanine aminotransferase and γ-glutamyltransferase (two [11%] each) in patients treated with garsorasib alone. Serious adverse events occurred in ten (30%) patients in the combination group and in four (22%) patients in the monotherapy group. One patient in the garsorasib monotherapy group died due to the underlying malignancy within 30 days after completing study treatment, which was reported as a serious adverse event. The death was assessed by the investigators as not related to garsorasib. No grade 4 treatment-related adverse events or treatment-related deaths were reported across all cohorts.
INTERPRETATION: The combination of ifebemtinib and garsorasib showed promising anticancer activity and manageable safety profile in previously treated patients with KRASG12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer. Although the improvement in response rate did not reach statistical significance in the randomised study, these findings support further evaluation of ifebemtinib plus garsorasib in this population.
FUNDING: InxMed, InventisBio, National Natural Science Foundation of China, the Jian Bing Ling Yan + X Research and Development Program of Zhejiang Province, and the Zhejiang Province Medical and Health Science and Technology Plan Project.

papers.title_zh: Ifebemtinib加上garsorasib治療先前已治療之KRASG12C突變轉移性大腸直腸癌：一項多中心、隨機、第1b/2期試驗
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Ifebemtinib是一種強效口服局灶黏著斑激酶（FAK）抑制劑。前臨床證據支持將ifebemtinib與KRASG12C抑制劑garsorasib合併使用。本研究旨在評估此組合治療於KRASG12C突變實體腫瘤之效果。方法：此為多中心第1b/2期研究，包含第1b期確立第2期建議劑量，以及第2期多腫瘤擴展試驗。第1b期以3+3設計評估ifebemtinib合併garsorasib於KRASG12C突變實體腫瘤之安全性與耐受性，未觀察到劑量限制性毒性，第2期建議劑量確立為ifebemtinib每日口服100mg加garsorasib每日口服兩次600mg。本文報告第2期擴展試驗中先前已治療之KRASG12C突變轉移性大腸直腸癌族群結果。符合資格者（年齡≥18歲）為經組織學確診之局部進展或轉移性大腸直腸癌，帶有KRASG12C突變，東部合作腫瘤學組體能狀態評分為0或1，且先前接受以irinotecan或oxaliplatin為基礎之併用療法後疾病仍進展，自中國九家參與三級醫院中的七家招募。基於建議之第2期劑量，第2期包含單臂研究評估ifebemtinib合併garsorasib之安全性與療效，以及一項開放標籤隨機研究，病人以1:1隨機分派（中央電腦生成區塊隨機化、無分層）接受ifebemtinib加garsorasib或garsorasib單獨治療。研究者對區塊大小保持盲性。第2期主要療效終點為研究者評估之客觀反應率（依RECIST 1.1版），單臂研究於安全性分析集中評估，隨機研究則於所有隨機分派病人（意向治療分析族群）中評估。單臂研究需至少6例客觀反應（安全性分析集）才能進入隨機研究。本研究已於ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號NCT06166836與NCT05379946，目前狀態為進行中但未招募。結果：2023年4月7日至2024年12月13日間，51名病人納入第2期（單臂研究15名，隨機研究36名）。單臂研究中，中位年齡53歲（IQR 39至63），9名（60%）為女性，6名（40%）為男性，全數為亞洲人。隨機研究中，聯合治療組中位年齡51歲（IQR 42至59），單藥治療組63歲（IQR 54至66），24名（67%）為女性，12名（33%）為男性，全數為亞洲人。單臂試驗中，確認的客觀反應率為46.7%（95% CI 21.3至73.4）。7名病人達部分反應，觸發進入隨機研究。隨機研究中，聯合治療之確認客觀反應率為38.9%（95% CI 17.3至64.3），garsorasib單藥組為16.7%（95% CI 3.6至41.4），組間差異22.2%（95% CI -7.7至49.1），單尾p=0.068。單臂研究中，15名病人中有4名（27%）發生第3級治療相關不良事件；隨機研究中，聯合治療組18名中有6名（33%）、garsorasib組18名中有5名（28%）發生第3級治療相關不良事件。發生於至少2名病人之第3級治療相關不良事件，於接受聯合治療之病人（合併計算）中為腹瀉（6例[18%]）、蛋白尿（2例[6%]）、腸阻塞（2例[6%]），於garsorasib單藥病人中為丙氨酸轉胺酶升高與γ-谷氨醯轉移酶升高（各2例[11%]）。嚴重不良事件於聯合治療組發生於10名（30%）病人，單藥治療組發生於4名（22%）病人。單藥治療組有1名病人於完成研究治療後30天內因潛在惡性腫瘤死亡，此事件被報告為嚴重不良事件，研究者評估與garsorasib無關。所有隊列均未報告第4級治療相關不良事件或治療相關死亡。解讀：Ifebemtinib合併garsorasib於先前已治療之KRASG12C突變轉移性大腸直腸癌病人中顯示具前景的抗癌活性與可管理之安全性。雖然隨機研究中反應率之改善未達統計顯著，但這些發現支持進一步評估ifebemtinib加garsorasib於此族群之應用。資金來源：InxMed、InventisBio、中國國家自然科學基金會、浙江省尖兵領雁+X研發計畫、浙江省醫藥衛生科技計畫項目。

papers.title: 2'-Fucosyllactose modulates gut microbiota and systemic metabolism in mild-to-moderate ulcerative colitis: a randomized crossover trial
papers.authors: Kennedy J, De Silva A, Morales P, Poveda Turrado C, Walton G, Gibson G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: The gut microbiota in active ulcerative colitis (UC) differs from that of healthy individuals. Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) are prebiotics found in human breastmilk which promote infant health, but are lesser studied in adults. The objective of this study was to assess the impact of the HMO 2'-fucosyllactose (2'-FL) on symptoms, inflammation, gut microbiota, and systemic metabolism in mild-to-moderate UC.
METHODS: In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover clinical trial, 38 patients with mild-to-moderate UC were randomized to receive 28 days of 2'-FL or 28 days of maltodextrin placebo, followed by washout and crossover. Patient-reported outcome measures, feces, urine, and serum samples were collected before and after each intervention, and after a final washout period.
RESULTS: Although no clear treatment effect was observed on conventional clinical indices, 2'-FL exposure was associated with improved patient-reported disease control. 2'-FL significantly modulated the gut microbiota, markedly increasing Bifidobacterium abundance (effect size 4.4%, 95% CI 2.33%-6.47%, P = 6.5 × 10-5). Fecal metabolite profiles showed changes consistent with altered microbial carbohydrate metabolism. Exploratory analyses suggested that age and baseline microbiota may influence clinical and biological responsiveness to 2'-FL.
CONCLUSIONS: 2'-FL exposure was associated with improvement in patient-reported disease control, gut microbiota modulation, and cross-compartmental host-microbial metabolic profile modifications; Clinicaltrials.gov number, NCT06050811.
papers.title_zh: 2'-岩藻糖基乳糖調節輕度至中度潰瘍性大腸炎患者的腸道微生物群與全身代謝：一項隨機交叉試驗
papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：活動性潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）患者的腸道微生物群與健康個體不同。人乳寡糖（HMOs）是存在於母乳中的益生元，可促進嬰兒健康，但在成人中研究較少。本研究目的為評估HMO成分2'-岩藻糖基乳糖（2'-FL）對輕度至中度UC患者症狀、發炎、腸道微生物群及全身代謝的影響。方法：本隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照交叉臨床試驗中，38名輕度至中度UC患者被隨機分配接受28天2'-FL或28天麥芽糊精安慰劑，隨後經過清洗期後交叉。於每次介入前後及最終清洗期後收集病人報告結果指標、糞便、尿液與血清樣本。結果：雖然在傳統臨床指標上未觀察到明顯治療效果，但2'-FL暴露與病人自述疾病控制改善相關。2'-FL顯著調節腸道微生物群，明顯增加雙歧桿菌（Bifidobacterium）豐度（效應量4.4%，95%信賴區間2.33%-6.47%，P = 6.5×10-5）。糞便代謝物譜顯示與微生物碳水化合物代謝改變一致的變化。探索性分析顯示年齡與基線微生物群可能影響對2'-FL的臨床與生物學反應性。結論：2'-FL暴露與病人自述疾病控制改善、腸道微生物群調節及跨體液宿主-微生物代謝譜改變相關；ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT06050811。
papers.score_reason: 設計嚴謹（雙盲交叉RCT）但主要臨床指標為陰性結果，僅次要/探索性指標（微生物群、病人自述）呈陽性，且與大腸直腸外科臨床實務關聯極低。

papers.title: Watch-and-wait after immunotherapy-containing neoadjuvant treatment in pMMR/MSS locally advanced rectal cancer: a multicenter real-world study
papers.authors: Luo Z, Xiang R, Shen R, Zhao H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Watch-and-wait (W&W) is an organ-preserving option for rectal cancer patients who achieve clinical complete response (cCR), but post-cCR outcomes after immunotherapy-containing neoadjuvant treatment in proficient mismatch repair (pMMR)/microsatellite stable (MSS) locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) remain unclear. We evaluated post-cCR oncological and organ-preservation outcomes in this selected population.
METHODS: This multicenter retrospective cohort study included patients with pMMR/MSS LARC who achieved cCR after immunotherapy-containing neoadjuvant treatment at three medical centers and subsequently underwent W&W. Eligible patients had at least 12 months of post-cCR follow-up. Disease progression, survival, and organ-preservation outcomes were evaluated, and survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method.
RESULTS: Twenty-five patients were included, with a median post-cCR follow-up of 26 months (range, 14-40 months). Three patients (12.0%) developed disease progression, including two with local regrowth and one with lung metastasis. Both local regrowths were treated with R0 salvage surgery. The estimated 2-year disease-free survival was 87.4% (95% CI, 65.7%-95.8%). Twenty-three patients (92.0%) avoided radical surgery, and 22 patients (88.0%) maintained disease-free organ preservation.
CONCLUSION: This multicenter study provides preliminary real-world evidence on W&W after cCR in highly selected patients with pMMR/MSS LARC treated with immunotherapy-containing neoadjuvant regimens, but larger prospective comparative studies with longer follow-up are required before its feasibility and oncological safety can be established.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：觀察等待（W&W）是直腸癌病人達到臨床完全緩解（cCR）後可選擇的器官保留策略，但在錯配修復功能正常（pMMR）/微衛星穩定（MSS）局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）中，接受含免疫治療之新輔助治療後達cCR的預後仍不明確。我們評估此特定族群達cCR後的腫瘤學結果與器官保留結果。方法：本多中心回溯性世代研究納入三個醫學中心中，接受含免疫治療之新輔助治療後達cCR並隨後採W&W策略的pMMR/MSS LARC病人。納入條件為cCR後至少追蹤12個月。以Kaplan-Meier法評估疾病進展、存活與器官保留結果。結果：共納入25名病人，cCR後中位追蹤26個月（範圍14-40個月）。3名病人（12.0%）發生疾病進展，其中2名為局部再生長，1名為肺轉移。兩例局部再生長皆以R0根治性搶救手術處理。估計2年無病存活率為87.4%（95% CI，65.7%-95.8%）。23名病人（92.0%）避免根治性手術，22名病人（88.0%）維持無病狀態下的器官保留。結論：本多中心研究提供了在接受含免疫治療新輔助治療方案的高度篩選pMMR/MSS LARC病人中，cCR後採W&W策略的初步真實世界證據，但在確立其可行性與腫瘤學安全性之前，仍需更大規模、追蹤時間更長的前瞻性對照研究。

papers.title: Exceptional treatment responses and molecular markers among 103 colorectal cancer cell lines
papers.authors: Sveen A, Stenersen J, Asenso T, Klokkerud S, Kranjec C, Eilertsen I
papers.abstract: Patients with colorectal cancer have few molecularly guided treatment options. Cancers with exceptional treatment response are valuable models for discovery of molecular response mechanisms and might reveal new predictive biomarkers to guide treatment selection. However, the rarity of events is a clinical challenge. We performed integrated high-throughput drug sensitivity testing (n = 620 drugs) and molecular analyses of 103 colorectal cancer cell lines to build an in vitro foundation for exceptional treatment responses and their molecular markers. Exceptional responses were scored by a two-way outlier detection approach and were identified in 67 unique cell line-drug pairs (0.13% of all pairs tested). This involved 35 cell lines (34.0%) and 49 drugs (7.9%) representing standard, experimental, and non-oncology drugs of diverse classes. Plausible response mechanisms on the gene, protein, and/or pathway expression levels were identified at baseline in 89.6% of the 67 pairs. Experimental validation confirmed treatment-induced marker suppression in seven of eight selected pairs, including target engagement of kinase inhibitors and downregulation of markers of extended response mechanisms. Recurrent exceptional sensitivity to the same drug in different cell lines involved functionally convergent molecular mechanisms, but rarely precisely the same marker. Most exceptional sensitivities (77.8%) could be predicted with multivariable transcriptomic models. In conclusion, this study provides in vitro support for biomarker-guided prescreening to potentially obtain exceptional treatment response to diverse drugs and therapeutic targets in colorectal cancer. Most exceptional responses have a clear molecular underpinning. The study also provides a large and openly available pharmaco-transcriptomics resource for colorectal cancer cell lines.
papers.title_zh: 103株大腸直腸癌細胞株中之例外治療反應與分子標記
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌患者目前可用的分子導向治療選項有限。呈現例外治療反應的癌症是發現分子反應機制的珍貴模型，可能揭示新的預測性生物標記以指導治療選擇。然而，此類事件的罕見性是臨床上的挑戰。我們對103株大腸直腸癌細胞株進行了整合性高通量藥物敏感性檢測（620種藥物）與分子分析，以建立例外治療反應及其分子標記的體外基礎。透過雙向異常值偵測法評分，在所有測試配對中鑑定出67個獨特的細胞株-藥物配對（佔所有配對的0.13%）具有例外反應。這涉及35株細胞株（34.0%）與49種藥物（7.9%），涵蓋標準、實驗性及非腫瘤學用藥等多種藥物類別。在67個配對中，89.6%於基線時可在基因、蛋白質及/或路徑表現層次找到合理的反應機制。實驗驗證在8組所選配對中確認7組具有治療誘導的標記抑制，包括激酶抑制劑的靶點作用及延伸反應機制標記的下調。不同細胞株對同一藥物反覆出現的例外敏感性涉及功能上匯聚的分子機制，但很少涉及完全相同的標記。大多數例外敏感性（77.8%）可透過多變量轉錄體模型預測。總結而言，本研究提供體外證據支持以生物標記導向的預先篩選，以期在大腸直腸癌中對多種藥物與治療靶點獲得例外治療反應。大多數例外反應具有明確的分子基礎。本研究亦提供一個大型且公開可用的大腸直腸癌細胞株藥物-轉錄體資源。

papers.title: The circadian-microbiome-immune axis in colorectal cancer: mechanisms of spatiotemporal immunosuppression and chronotherapeutic horizons
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a major global oncological challenge, largely because most microsatellite-stable (MSS) tumors exhibit intrinsic resistance to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). Emerging evidence suggests that the gut microbiome and host circadian rhythm jointly regulate mucosal homeostasis; however, their dynamic integration-defined here as the circadian-microbiome-immune axis-remains incompletely understood in CRC. In this review, we synthesize preclinical findings and the limited available clinical evidence concerning this axis. Experimental studies using genetic and lifestyle-related models of circadian disruption indicate that clock dysfunction may impair the intestinal mucosal barrier and alter microbial composition, including depletion of beneficial taxa such as Lactobacillus. These changes have been associated with metabolic remodeling, including increased taurocholic acid (TCA), which has been shown in cell and animal models to activate the RasGRF1/MAPK/ERK pathway. Preclinical evidence further suggests that intestinal clock disruption may interact with Wnt signaling and chemokine networks, including CXCL5 and IL-17, thereby promoting the rhythmic recruitment of PD-L1-expressing myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs). On this basis, we propose the Temporal Immunosuppressive Shield (TIS) as a hypothesis-generating conceptual framework linking epithelial barrier dysfunction, microbial metabolic remodeling, and temporally gated myeloid-mediated suppression of cytotoxic CD8+ T cells. Because this integrated model has not yet been directly validated in human MSS CRC, it should not be regarded as an established biological mechanism. We also discuss the potential of biologically phase-aligned ICB and chemotherapy, conceptually termed chronoimmunotherapy, while emphasizing current challenges in circadian biomarker development, interindividual variability, and mouse-to-human translation. Overall, this review outlines a testable spatiotemporal framework and identifies the experimental and clinical studies required to evaluate its relevance to therapeutic resistance in CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球重大腫瘤學挑戰，主要原因是大多數微衛星穩定（MSS）腫瘤對免疫檢查點阻斷（ICB）具有內在抗藥性。新興證據顯示腸道微生物群與宿主生理時鐘共同調控黏膜穩態；然而兩者在CRC中的動態整合——本文稱之為生理時鐘-微生物-免疫軸——仍未被完全理解。本綜述整合了此軸相關的前臨床發現與有限的臨床證據。使用基因與生活型態相關的生理時鐘失調模型之實驗研究顯示，時鐘功能異常可能損害腸道黏膜屏障並改變微生物組成，包括益菌如乳酸桿菌（Lactobacillus）的減少。這些改變與代謝重塑相關，包括牛磺膽酸（TCA）增加，已在細胞與動物模型中證實可活化RasGRF1/MAPK/ERK路徑。前臨床證據further顯示腸道時鐘失調可能與Wnt訊號及趨化因子網路（包括CXCL5與IL-17）交互作用，進而促進表現PD-L1的骨髓源性抑制細胞（MDSCs）的節律性招募。基於此，我們提出「時間性免疫抑制屏障」（Temporal Immunosuppressive Shield, TIS）作為一個假說生成性的概念框架，連結上皮屏障功能障礙、微生物代謝重塑，以及時間性調控的骨髓細胞介導的CD8+細胞毒性T細胞抑制。由於此整合模型尚未在人類MSS CRC中直接驗證，不應將其視為已確立的生物學機轉。我們同時討論生物學相位對齊的ICB與化學治療（概念上稱為時間免疫治療，chronoimmunotherapy）之潛力，並強調生理時鐘生物標記開發、個體間變異性及小鼠到人類轉譯上目前面臨的挑戰。總體而言，本綜述提出一個可測試的時空框架，並指出評估其與CRC治療抗藥性相關性所需的實驗與臨床研究。

papers.title: Modifiable lifestyle factors in early life and inflammatory bowel disease risk in two birth cohorts
papers.authors: Guo A, Sigvardsson I, Imberg H, Lerchova T, Ludvigsson J, Størdal K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Early life may be a critical period for the development of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) susceptibility. The aim was to examine the association between early-life adherence to a healthy lifestyle and later IBD risk.
METHODS: In two Scandinavian birth cohorts (1997-2009), we developed the a priori Modifiable Health-related Lifestyle Score (MHLS) and an empirically weighted Optimal Risk Score (ORS) by ages 1 and 3 years, incorporating data on smoking exposure, delivery mode, breastfeeding, diet quality, antibiotic use, physical activity, and body mass index. Linked national registers identified diagnoses of any IBD, Crohn's disease (CD), and ulcerative colitis (UC) through 2023-2024. Cox regression and random-effects models, adjusted for parental IBD and sociodemographic characteristics, were used to estimate pooled hazard ratios (aHRs) across MHLS and ORS tertiles.
RESULTS: By a mean age of 20 years at the end of follow-up, 732 of 117 487 participants were diagnosed with IBD. Children with high vs low MHLS by age 1 year had a reduced risk of later IBD (aHR = 0.77 [95% CI = 0.61-0.98]), particularly CD (aHR = 0.57 [0.38-0.86]). ORS analyses yielded estimates nearly identical to MHLS by age 1 year and showed that high vs low adherence to a healthy lifestyle by age 3 was associated with a reduced risk of IBD (aHR = 0.77 [95% CI = 0.63-0.95]) and CD (aHR = 0.68 [95% CI = 0.49-0.94]), but not of UC. Associations were similar for childhood-onset IBD.
CONCLUSION: A healthy lifestyle in early childhood was associated with a reduced risk of IBD, particularly CD, suggesting that early lifestyle modifications may help prevent the disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：生命早期可能是發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）易感性發展的關鍵時期。本研究旨在檢視生命早期健康生活型態遵從度與後續IBD風險之間的關聯。方法：在兩個斯堪地那維亞出生世代（1997-2009年）中，我們建立了基於先驗理論的「可調整健康相關生活型態評分」（MHLS）以及以經驗權重計算的「最適風險評分」（ORS），評分時間點為1歲及3歲，納入吸菸暴露、生產方式、母乳哺育、飲食品質、抗生素使用、身體活動及身體質量指數等資料。透過全國性連結登錄資料庫，追蹤至2023-2024年，確認任何IBD、克隆氏症（CD）及潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）的診斷。使用Cox迴歸及隨機效應模型，調整父母IBD病史及社會人口學特徵，估計MHLS及ORS三分位數間的合併風險比（aHR）。結果：追蹤結束時平均年齡20歲，117487名參與者中有732人被診斷為IBD。1歲時MHLS高分組相較低分組，後續IBD風險降低（aHR = 0.77 [95% CI = 0.61-0.98]），尤其是CD（aHR = 0.57 [0.38-0.86]）。ORS分析結果與1歲時的MHLS幾乎相同，並顯示3歲時健康生活型態高遵從度與IBD風險降低相關（aHR = 0.77 [95% CI = 0.63-0.95]）及CD（aHR = 0.68 [95% CI = 0.49-0.94]），但與UC無關。兒童發病型IBD的關聯結果相似。結論：幼兒期健康生活型態與較低的IBD風險相關，尤其是CD，顯示早期生活型態調整可能有助於預防此疾病。

papers.title: Frequency and prognostic outcomes of emergency diagnosis in 13 non-neoplastic conditions in England: A population-based cohort study using linked electronic health records of 1.7 million patients
papers.authors: Whitfield E, White B, Barclay M, Rafiq M, Zakkak N, Berglund M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: In patients with cancer, diagnosis through or soon after the use of emergency hospital care ('emergency diagnosis') is associated with advanced disease and poor prognosis. The varied and complex reasons for emergency diagnoses-including rapid disease progression, patient factors, and system delays-are unlikely to be unique to cancer. However, little is known about the frequency and prognostic outcomes of emergency diagnosis in other conditions. We aimed to document the frequency of emergency diagnoses across various non-neoplastic conditions and examine the association of emergency diagnosis with clinical outcomes.
METHODS AND FINDINGS: We analysed records from linked primary care, secondary care, and death data (Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD), Hospital Episode Statistics, Office for National Statistics) for 1,701,154 patients with one of 13 exemplar conditions (axial spondyloarthritis, coeliac disease, coronary/ischaemic heart disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), Lyme disease, multiple sclerosis (MS), Parkinson's disease, polycystic ovary syndrome, rheumatoid arthritis, schizophrenia, subacute bacterial endocarditis, and tuberculosis) in England between 1999 and 2019. We examined the percentage of patients diagnosed as an emergency and compared their mortality and time in hospital in the year post-diagnosis with patients who were not diagnosed as an emergency. Emergency diagnosis occurred in at least 20% of patients for 9 out of 13 conditions in our sample, including more than 30% of patients with Parkinson's disease and 35% of patients with COPD. For 9 out of 13 conditions, there was a substantial increase (at least +10% difference) in 1-year mortality in patients diagnosed as an emergency versus patients who were not diagnosed as an emergency. After adjusting for age and year of diagnosis, deprivation, comorbidity burden, and the healthcare setting in which the diagnosis was made, patients diagnosed as an emergency were typically much more likely to die within one year. This association held even in conditions with generally good prognosis, such as coeliac disease (adjusted odds ratio 7.53, 95% CI [5.64, 10.1], women) and IBD (adjusted odds ratio 5.99, 95% CI [5.30, 6.78], men). Similarly large differences were observed for time in hospital in the year post-diagnosis by emergency diagnosis status. For example, adjusted rate ratios of 8.76 (95% CI [6.52, 11.8]) for men with coeliac disease, and 5.59 (95%CI [2.57, 12.2]) for women diagnosed with Lyme disease. The findings were consistent across two subsets of CPRD data (Aurum, GOLD). Analyses of patients with five supplementary cancer sites (brain, colon, lung, pancreas, and ovary) produced findings concordant with prior literature, supporting the validity of the study methods. The main study limitation is the assumption of accurate recording of diagnoses in health records.
CONCLUSIONS: Emergency diagnosis is common and associated with worse clinical outcomes in a wide range of conditions with diverse aetiology. Further research and investment to reduce the number of emergency diagnoses is needed, particularly for diseases where diagnosis in community settings should be expected (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis and COPD), and conditions such as coeliac disease, IBD, and MS, where emergency diagnosis is associated with particularly poor outcomes.
papers.title_zh: 英格兰170万名患者的连结式电子健康记录人群队列研究：13种非肿瘤性疾病的急诊诊断频率与预后结果
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：在癌症患者中，透过急诊就医途径或急诊就医后不久确诊（「急诊诊断」）与晚期疾病及不良预后相关。造成急诊诊断的原因复杂多样——包括疾病快速进展、患者因素、系统延迟——这些原因不太可能只限于癌症。然而，对于其他疾病中急诊诊断的频率与预后结果所知甚少。我们旨在记录多种非肿瘤性疾病中急诊诊断的频率，并检视急诊诊断与临床结果之间的关联。

方法与结果：我们分析了连结的基层医疗、次级医疗与死亡数据（Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD)、Hospital Episode Statistics、Office for National Statistics），涵盖1999年至2019年间英格兰1,701,154名罹患13种范例疾病之一的患者（中轴型脊椎关节炎、乳糜泻、冠状动脉/缺血性心脏病、慢性阻塞性肺病(COPD)、炎症性肠病(IBD)、莱姆病、多发性硬化症(MS)、帕金森氏症、多囊性卵巢症候群、类风湿性关节炎、精神分裂症、亚急性细菌性心内膜炎、结核病）。我们检视被诊断为急诊的患者百分比，并比较其诊断后一年内的死亡率与住院时间，与非急诊诊断的患者相比。13种疾病中有9种，急诊诊断发生率至少达20%，其中帕金森氏症超过30%、COPD达35%。13种疾病中有9种，急诊诊断患者与非急诊诊断患者相比，一年死亡率有显著增加（至少+10%差异）。经年龄、诊断年份、社会剥夺程度、共病负担及诊断场所调整后，急诊诊断的患者通常死于一年内的可能性显著较高。此关联在预后通常良好的疾病中依然存在，例如乳糜泻（调整后OR 7.53，95% CI [5.64, 10.1]，女性）与IBD（调整后OR 5.99，95% CI [5.30, 6.78]，男性）。诊断后一年内住院时间的差异也同样显著，例如男性乳糜泻患者的调整后发生率比为8.76（95% CI [6.52, 11.8]），女性莱姆病患者为5.59（95% CI [2.57, 12.2]）。研究发现在CPRD两个子数据集（Aurum、GOLD）中一致。对五种补充癌症部位（脑、结肠、肺、胰脏、卵巢）的分析结果与先前文献一致，支持本研究方法的有效性。主要研究限制为假设健康记录中诊断记录的准确性。

结论：急诊诊断在多种病因各异的疾病中相当常见，且与较差的临床结果相关。需要更多研究与投入以减少急诊诊断的数量，尤其是那些应该在社区场所即可诊断的疾病（如类风湿性关节炎与COPD），以及急诊诊断与特别不良预后相关的疾病，如乳糜泻、IBD与MS。

papers.title: ST6GAL1-mediated sialyl linkage switching drives cancer-promoting α2,6-sialo-protrusions radiating from anti-inflammatory TAMs
papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
papers.journal_full: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.authors: Dipta P, Bansal N, Chien A, Sumer-Bayraktar Z, Onizuka H, Kasugai D
papers.abstract: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are functionally diverse effector cells in the tumor microenvironment (TME). Pro- and anti-inflammatory TAMs are central to cancer progression by shaping inflammation and immune homeostasis, but it remains unknown if polarization-induced remodeling of the TAM glycocalyx critical for cellular communication and interactions occurs within the TME. Taking a systems glycobiology approach, we first used cell surface-focused glycomics and lectin flow cytometry of ex vivo polarized monocyte-derived macrophages to demonstrate profound sialyl linkage switching in proinflammatory (α2,3-sialo-favored) and anti-inflammatory (α2,6-sialo-dominant) macrophages. ST6GAL1 catalyzing α2,6-sialylation was found to be elevated in anti-inflammatory compared to proinflammatory macrophages, suggesting that this glycoenzyme facilitates sialyl linkage switching, which was supported by ST6GAL1 silencing. Sambucus nigra agglutinin (SNA)-focused lectin cytochemistry of anti-inflammatory macrophages revealed dense networks of dynamic α2,6-sialylated protein-based protrusions forming interconnecting extracellular structures that were absent in proinflammatory macrophages. Temporal ST6GAL1 suppression in anti-inflammatory macrophages disintegrated the cellular protrusions as evidenced by SNA and biotin fluorescence microscopy. Moreover, live cell recordings of anti-inflammatory macrophages cultured with and without colorectal cancer (CRC) cells showed reduced macrophage motility, attenuated intermacrophage and macrophage-CRC cell interactions and diminished CRC cell proliferation upon ST6GAL1 suppression indicating functional roles of the sialo-protrusions. Notably, ST6GAL1 silencing in anti-inflammatory macrophages promoted transition toward proinflammatory-like phenotypes, as supported by altered morphology, phagocytotic capacity, and Siglec and cytokine expression. Finally, sialyl linkage switching was recapitulated in pro- and anti-inflammatory TAMs in tumor tissues of patients with advanced CRC. We report on the mechanistic basis for and functional consequences of glycocalyx remodeling accompanying TAM polarization.
papers.title_zh: ST6GAL1介導的唾液酸連結轉換驅動源自抗炎性腫瘤相關巨噬細胞（TAM）之促癌α2,6-唾液酸化偽足突起
papers.abstract_zh: 腫瘤相關巨噬細胞（TAMs）是腫瘤微環境（TME）中功能多樣的效應細胞。促炎與抗炎性TAMs透過塑造炎症反應與免疫平衡，在癌症進展中扮演核心角色，但極化作用是否會誘導對細胞間通訊與交互作用至關重要的TAM糖萼重塑，目前尚屬未知。本研究採用系統糖生物學方法，首先利用細胞表面聚焦糖組學及凝集素流式細胞術，分析體外極化之單核球衍生巨噬細胞，證實促炎（偏好α2,3-唾液酸化）與抗炎（以α2,6-唾液酸化為主）巨噬細胞間存在顯著的唾液酸連結轉換。發現催化α2,6-唾液酸化的ST6GAL1在抗炎性巨噬細胞中較促炎性巨噬細胞表現升高，提示此糖基化酶促進唾液酸連結轉換，此現象亦經ST6GAL1基因靜默實驗支持。以接骨木凝集素（SNA）為主之凝集素細胞化學法顯示，抗炎性巨噬細胞具有密集且動態的α2,6-唾液酸化蛋白基底偽足突起網絡，形成互連的細胞外結構，而此結構在促炎性巨噬細胞中不存在。在抗炎性巨噬細胞中暫時抑制ST6GAL1會導致細胞突起結構瓦解，此現象經SNA及生物素螢光顯微鏡證實。此外，將抗炎性巨噬細胞與大腸直腸癌（CRC）細胞共培養之活細胞影像記錄顯示，抑制ST6GAL1後巨噬細胞移動能力下降、巨噬細胞間及巨噬細胞與CRC細胞間交互作用減弱，且CRC細胞增殖減少，顯示唾液酸偽足突起具有功能性作用。值得注意的是，在抗炎性巨噬細胞中靜默ST6GAL1可促使其轉變為類促炎性表型，此結果由細胞形態、吞噬能力及Siglec與細胞因子表現的改變所支持。最後，研究團隊在晚期CRC患者腫瘤組織之促炎與抗炎性TAMs中重現了唾液酸連結轉換現象。本研究報告了伴隨TAM極化之糖萼重塑的機轉基礎及其功能性後果。

papers.title: The dual roles of lysine-specific demethylase 1 (KDM1A/LSD1) in the modulation of tumor immune microenvironment and its inhibitors in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Wang Y, Zhou W, Jia G, Huang X, Song Z
papers.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have demonstrated significant potential in cancer therapy. However, the immunosuppressive nature of the tumor microenvironment (TME) and ICI remains a major challenge in clinical treatment. Recently, epigenetic regulators, such as the histone demethylase Lysine (K)-Specific Demethylase 1 A(KDM1A/LSD1), have participated in tumor progression and immune evasion by reshaping the epigenetic state of tumor cells and the immune microenvironment. This study systematically reviewed the dual role of KDM1A in colorectal cancer (CRC). On one hand, KDM1A can promote tumor cell proliferation and aberrant differentiation by regulating signaling pathways, such as Wnt/β-catenin and Notch. On the other hand, it can also modulate the functions of T cells, B cells, macrophages, and Natural Killer (NK)cells through epigenetic modifications, thus inhibiting antitumor immune responses and creating an immunosuppressive microenvironment. Notably, KDM1A can reduce the immunogenicity of CRC by downregulating tumor antigen presentation or pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion, thus enhancing the tumor's resistance to ICI. Clinically, small-molecule inhibitors targeting KDM1A, such as Tranylcypromine (TCP) and Iadademstat, could enhance the efficacy of ICIs by reversing the immunosuppressive microenvironment, especially in mismatch repair proficient (pMMR) CRC. Future studies should further elucidate the molecular networks of KDM1A regulating immunogenicity and explore the synergistic mechanisms of its inhibitors with other epigenetic drugs or immunotherapies in order to provide new strategies for overcoming CRC resistance to immunotherapies.

papers.abstract_zh: 免疫檢查點抑制劑 (ICIs) 在癌症治療上已展現顯著潛力。然而，腫瘤微環境 (TME) 的免疫抑制特性與ICI仍是臨床治療上的主要挑戰。近來，表觀遺傳調控因子，如組蛋白去甲基化酶賴氨酸(K)特異性去甲基化酶1A (KDM1A/LSD1)，透過重塑腫瘤細胞與免疫微環境的表觀遺傳狀態，參與腫瘤進展與免疫逃逸。本研究系統性回顧了KDM1A在大腸直腸癌 (CRC) 中的雙重角色。一方面，KDM1A可透過調控Wnt/β-catenin與Notch等訊息傳遞路徑，促進腫瘤細胞增殖與異常分化；另一方面，它也可透過表觀遺傳修飾調節T細胞、B細胞、巨噬細胞與自然殺手 (NK) 細胞的功能，進而抑制抗腫瘤免疫反應並形成免疫抑制微環境。值得注意的是，KDM1A可透過下調腫瘤抗原呈現或促發炎細胞激素分泌，降低CRC的免疫原性，進而增強腫瘤對ICI的抗性。臨床上，針對KDM1A的小分子抑制劑，如Tranylcypromine (TCP) 與Iadademstat，可透過逆轉免疫抑制微環境來增強ICI療效，尤其在錯配修復功能正常 (pMMR) 的CRC中更為顯著。未來研究應進一步闡明KDM1A調控免疫原性的分子網絡，並探討其抑制劑與其他表觀遺傳藥物或免疫治療的協同機轉，以提供克服CRC對免疫治療抗性的新策略。

papers.title: Clinical pearls and pitfalls in inborn errors of immunity: An expert-derived framework for diagnostic pattern recognition
papers.journal_full: Pediatric allergy and immunology : official publication of the European Society of Pediatric Allergy and Immunology
papers.authors: Vásquez Echeverri E, Bustamante-Ogando J, Castano-Jaramillo L, Vélez Tirado N, Venegas Montoya E, Gómez Tello H
papers.abstract: Inborn errors of immunity (IEI) encompass over 600 disorders with diverse and overlapping presentations. Clinicians rely on pattern recognition-clinical pearls-to navigate this complexity, yet this experiential knowledge is rarely systematically compiled. Through a structured expert elicitation, we aimed to capture and organize clinical pearls, pitfalls, and caveats for the differential diagnosis of IEI as a practical educational reference for trainees and non-specialist physicians. In a structured expert survey with narrative (thematic) synthesis-not a formal consensus process-twenty clinical immunologists were invited and twelve contributed (60% response). Each provided diagnostic pearls across six categories: red flags prompting IEI evaluation, signs suggestive of IEI categories, highly specific (near-pathognomonic) findings, highly sensitive findings, expected phenotype (including exclusionary findings), and practical clinical wisdom. Responses were translated (Spanish to English where necessary), coded and synthesized by theme by two investigators with disagreements resolved by consensus, reviewed for contradictions, and supplemented with established pearls from the literature, with the origin of each pearl tracked. Contributors provided over 150 diagnostic pearls. High-consensus red flags included disseminated BCG/mycobacterial disease, very early-onset inflammatory bowel disease (<6 years), and infant lymphopenia. Highly specific findings included microthrombocytopenia for Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome, catalase-positive organism infections for chronic granulomatous disease, and ataxia with telangiectasias for ataxia-telangiectasia. Important caveats emerged: normal mean platelet volume does not exclude Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome; normal IgG in older ataxia-telangiectasia patients may mask antibody deficiency due to oligoclonal production; and absence of fever during serious bacterial infection suggests IRAK4/MyD88 deficiency rather than arguing against it. Contributors emphasized that clinical phenotypes evolve over time and that patients may not fit established patterns at initial evaluation. This structured expert survey provides a practical, organized reference for IEI differential diagnosis. The compilation of pearls, pitfalls, and caveats, presented in eight tables, offers educational and hypothesis-generating guidance for clinicians and trainees navigating these rare disorders. In an exploratory, qualitative comparison, several types of experiential clinical wisdom-bedside decision rules, laboratory caveats, environmental guidance, and anticipatory management-were underrepresented in the outputs of general-purpose large language models informally queried on the same task, suggesting that expert-derived knowledge of this kind may help inform future educational and diagnostic-support efforts.
papers.title_zh: 先天性免疫錯誤的臨床要點與陷阱：一個專家衍生的診斷模式識別框架
papers.abstract_zh: 先天性免疫錯誤（IEI）涵蓋超過600種疾病，臨床表現多樣且相互重疊。臨床醫師依賴模式識別（即臨床要點）來應對此複雜性，然而這類經驗性知識鮮少被系統性整理。本研究透過結構化專家意見徵集，旨在收集並整理IEI鑑別診斷的臨床要點、陷阱與注意事項，作為給受訓醫師與非專科醫師的實用教育參考。在採用敘事（主題式）綜合分析的結構化專家調查中（非正式共識程序），邀請20位臨床免疫學家，12位提供回應（回應率60%）。每位受訪者依六個類別提供診斷要點：促使IEI評估的紅旗徵象、提示IEI類別的徵象、高特異性（近乎病理特徵性）發現、高敏感性發現、預期表現型（包括排除性發現），以及實務臨床智慧。回應經翻譯（必要時西班牙文譯為英文）、由兩位研究者編碼並依主題綜合分析，意見分歧經共識解決，並檢視矛盾之處，再輔以文獻中既有要點補充，並追蹤每個要點的來源。受訪者提供超過150項診斷要點。高度共識的紅旗徵象包括：瀰漫性BCG／分枝桿菌感染、極早發型發炎性腸道疾病（<6歲）、以及嬰兒淋巴球減少症。高特異性發現包括：Wiskott-Aldrich症候群的微小血小板減少症、慢性肉芽腫病的過氧化氫酶陽性菌感染、以及運動失調合併毛細血管擴張症的運動失調-毛細血管擴張症。重要注意事項包括：正常平均血小板體積並不能排除Wiskott-Aldrich症候群；年長運動失調-毛細血管擴張症患者的正常IgG可能因寡株性抗體產生而掩蓋抗體缺乏症；嚴重細菌感染時無發燒反而提示IRAK4/MyD88缺乏症，而非排除此診斷。受訪者強調臨床表現型會隨時間演變，患者在初次評估時可能不符合既定模式。本結構化專家調查提供IEI鑑別診斷的實用、有組織的參考。以八個表格呈現的要點、陷阱與注意事項彙編，為臨床醫師與受訓者處理這些罕見疾病提供教育性與假說生成性的指引。在一項探索性、質性比較中，若干類型的經驗性臨床智慧（床邊決策規則、實驗室注意事項、環境指引、預期性管理）在通用型大型語言模型對同一任務的非正式詢問輸出中呈現不足，提示此類專家衍生知識可能有助於未來的教育與診斷支援工作。

papers.title: One Patient, Two Problems: Applying Short Bowel Syndrome Management Principles in Inflammatory Bowel Disease patients
papers.authors: Chiplunker A, Burton J, Koehler B, Bechtold M
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Surgery for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) often results in alterations in gut function beyond the anatomical changes. While some patients develop short bowel syndrome (SBS), a significant proportion of IBD patients benefit from pharmacologic and dietary interventions for SBS even in the absence of true SBS or IF.
RECENT FINDINGS: While no formal criteria exist to clearly define the presence of SBS in IBD patients, the presence of specific features in the surgical and clinical history are crucial to the rapid identification of SBS or IF in IBD patients. Anatomy specific dietary considerations and interventions provide significant benefits and lay the foundation for a structured approach to optimizing anti-motility and adjunctive therapies. IBD patients with post-surgical anatomy benefit from management strategies used in patients in SBS. Optimal dosing of anti-motility agents and oral rehydration solution form the foundations of management in all practice settings.

papers.title: Noninvasive molecular imaging signatures of histopathological growth patterns in colorectal cancer liver metastases
papers.authors: Vierasu I, Sclafani F, Van Laethem J, Delbart W, Doumont G, Bohlok A
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM) are characterized by distinct histopathological growth patterns (HGPs), desmoplastic (dHGP) also called encapsulated, replacement (rHGP) and pushing (pHGP) types, which have major prognostic and therapeutic implications. HGPs can only be determined histologically after surgical resection. This review explores molecular imaging as a potential in vivo approach to predict and characterize HGPs non-invasively. Based on the biological hallmarks of each pattern regarding glucose metabolism, angiogenesis, hypoxia, fibrotic stromal activation and immune contexture, we outline how specific PET tracers can capture these features. [18F]FDG PET reflects glycolytic activity; angiogenesis-specific tracers such as arginine-glycine-aspartic acid (RGD) peptides targeting integrins or VEGF-based agents may reflect the neovascularization typical of dHGP. Hypoxia PET may detect oxygen-deprived tumour regions. Fibroblast activation protein inhibitor (FAPI) tracers provide a quantitative marker of fibrotic stromal encapsulation, and immune PET may help distinguish between immune-active dHGP lesions and immune-cold rHGP types. These proposed molecular imaging signatures provide a biologically informed framework for the non-invasive HGPs characterization but remain hypothesis-generating and require prospective translational and clinical validation.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌肝轉移組織病理生長模式之非侵入性分子影像特徵
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）具有獨特的組織病理生長模式（HGPs），包括促結締組織增生型（dHGP，亦稱包膜型）、置換型（rHGP）與推擠型（pHGP），這些模式在預後與治療上具有重大意義。目前HGP只能在手術切除後透過組織學判定。本綜述探討分子影像作為一種潛在的活體非侵入性方法，用以預測與辨識HGP。基於各生長模式在葡萄糖代謝、血管新生、缺氧、纖維化間質活化與免疫微環境上的生物學特徵，我們概述了特定PET探針如何捕捉這些特徵。[18F]FDG PET反映糖解活性；針對integrin的RGD胜肽或VEGF相關探針等血管新生特異性探針，可能反映dHGP典型的新生血管形成。缺氧PET可偵測缺氧腫瘤區域。纖維母細胞活化蛋白抑制劑（FAPI）探針提供纖維化間質包膜的量化指標，而免疫PET可能有助於區分免疫活躍的dHGP病灶與免疫冷的rHGP類型。這些分子影像特徵提供了一個具生物學基礎的框架，用於非侵入性HGP判定，但仍屬假說產生階段，需要前瞻性轉譯與臨床驗證。

papers.title: Pesticide Residues, Gut Microbiota, and Gastrointestinal Outcomes: A Scoping Review of Human Evidence
papers.journal: Compr Rev Food Sci Food Saf
papers.journal_full: Comprehensive reviews in food science and food safety
papers.authors: Ye C, Wu Q, Wang Z, Zhang C
papers.abstract: Vegetables anchor healthy-diet recommendations yet are the principal nonoccupational route by which residues of organophosphate (OP), pyrethroid, neonicotinoid, organochlorine (OC), and glyphosate herbicide enter the diet, with the gut microbiota a plausible mediator linking these residues to functional gastrointestinal (GI) and inflammatory bowel outcomes. We conducted a scoping review following the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR), searching PubMed (2010 to April 2026) with mandatory backward and forward citation tracing for human studies of dietary or biomarker-confirmed pesticide exposure against gut microbiota, intestinal barrier and inflammation, functional GI disorders, or inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Risk of bias (RoB) was appraised with ROBINS-E and Cochrane RoB 2.0, and evidence was synthesized in a 60-cell pesticide-class × outcome gap matrix. Twenty-eight papers were retained; 20 full-text-extracted human studies entered the synthesis, populating 20 of 60 cells (33%). The strongest convergent within-scope signal was OC exposure × IBD, where three cohorts agreed in direction (hazard ratios 1.56-1.61; Faroese risk ratio 3.04 on 37 cases). As a microbiota-mediation exemplar for an adjacent non-GI endpoint, the MCMC Nanjing pregnancy cohort linked a pesticide environmental risk score to gestational diabetes (adjusted odds ratio 4.5; 95% CI, 1.4-13.8; internal-validation area under the curve 0.83), with a Dorea-branch microbiota mediating part of the path. Glyphosate × IBD and neonicotinoid × any GI outcome remained empty. RoB centered on Moderate (11 of 22 rated cohorts), with six elevated-bias contributors. Biomarker-anchored prospective cohorts targeting the empty cells should be the next research priority.
papers.title_zh: 農藥殘留、腸道菌群與胃腸道結果：人類證據的範疇綜述
papers.abstract_zh: 蔬菜是健康飲食建議的基石，卻也是有機磷（OP）、擬除蟲菊酯、新菸鹼類、有機氯（OC）及嘉磷塞除草劑殘留進入飲食的主要非職業暴露途徑，腸道菌群被認為是連結這些殘留與功能性胃腸道（GI）及發炎性腸道結果之間的合理中介因子。我們依循PRISMA-ScR進行範疇綜述，檢索PubMed（2010年至2026年4月），並強制進行前向與後向引文追溯，納入探討飲食或生物標記確認之農藥暴露與腸道菌群、腸道屏障與發炎、功能性GI疾患或發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）關係的人類研究。以ROBINS-E與Cochrane RoB 2.0評估偏誤風險，並以60格「農藥類別×結果」缺口矩陣進行證據綜整。共納入28篇論文；20篇完整全文萃取的人類研究進入綜整分析，填補了60格中的20格（33%）。範圍內最強的一致訊號為OC暴露×IBD，三個世代研究方向一致（風險比1.56-1.61；法羅群島風險比為3.04，基於37例）。作為腸道菌群中介作用於相鄰非GI結果的範例，南京MCMC妊娠世代研究將農藥環境風險評分與妊娠糖尿病相連（調整後勝算比4.5；95%信賴區間1.4-13.8；內部驗證AUC為0.83），其中Dorea屬相關菌群中介了部分路徑。嘉磷塞×IBD及新菸鹼類×任何GI結果仍為空白。偏誤風險以中等為主（22個評分世代中11個為中等），有6項貢獻高偏誤風險。以生物標記為基礎的前瞻性世代研究，針對空白格進行填補，應為下一步研究優先方向。
